name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: Streamed command output (build, deploy, job logs). ANSI SGR colours map to contrast-safe tokens (`parseAnsi` is exported), `\r` progress lines rewrite in place, and a line cap drops the oldest output. It follows the tail until the user scrolls up, then offers “Jump to latest” with the count of new lines. Optional line numbers and timestamps, a wrap toggle, copy all and search with highlighted matches. The output is a `role="log"` with aria-live off unless `live` opts in. Stream through the `ref` handle (`write`, `writeln`, `clear`) or pass `lines`.
author: gntik-ai
